rubric_items.reason: Web-only change inside existing SettingsPage.tsx, reusing the existing /doctors route, its URL filters, the query helper and Link; no new module, API, type or infrastructure.
Every story is mapped to components and every AC has a path, but the REQ-3 count/list match for S-1/S-2 AC2 rests on an uncited assumption about how GET /api/doctors treats a missing status.
Link URLs and the aria-label wording are exact and testable; no endpoint fields change. The row field the link reads (doctorCount) and the id format are not tied to the cited RefEntry type.

Several code behaviours (RefList renders the Doctors cell, RefEntry fields, Kind values, query dropping empty values, API status default) are cited only by a symbol id or not at all, yet assumed: [] is empty.
Four trade-off lines cover aria-label, helper location, param mapping and omitting status. Using the API client's query helper to build a router link is not weighed against a literal URL.
Short, consistent, with a clear story mapping and Known section.
